dbspec.name: Transaction
dbspec.source-query: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RUN_TIMESTAMP as RunTimestamp , SRC_TXN_UNIQUE_ID as SrcTxnUniqueId , SRC_TXN_NUM as SrcTxnNum , ORGUNIT_CODE as OrgUnitCode , DB_RESP_ORGUNIT_CODE as DbRespOrgUnitCode , DB_RESP_ACCOUNT_ID as DbRespAccountSrcUniqueId , DB_RESP_CUST_ID as DbRespCustSrcUniqueId , ORIG_CPARTY_ID as OriginCPartySrcUniqueId , ORIG_SUBCUST_ID as OriginSubCustSrcUniqueId , ORIG_ACCOUNT_NUMBER as OriginAccountNumber , ORIG_CPARTY_ACCOUNT_ID as OrigCpartyAccountId , ORIG_COUNTRY_CODE as OriginCountryCode , ORIG_BANK_COUNTRY_CODE as OriginBankCountryCode , CR_RESP_ORGUNIT_CODE as CrRespOrgUnitCode , CR_RESP_ACCOUNT_ID as CrRespAccountSrcUniqueId , CR_RESP_CUST_ID as CrRespCustSrcUniqueId , BENE_CPARTY_ID as BeneCPartySrcUniqueId , BENE_SUBCUST_ID as BeneSubCustSrcUniqueId , BENE_CPARTY_ACCOUNT_ID as BeneCpartyAccountId , BENE_ACCOUNT_NUMBER as BeneAccountNumber , BENE_COUNTRY_CODE as BeneCountryCode , BENE_BANK_COUNTRY_CODE as BeneBankCountryCode , CURRENCY_CODE_ORIG as CurrencyCodeOrig , TXN_AMOUNT_BASE as TxnAmountBase , TXN_AMOUNT_ORIG as TxnAmountOrig , TXN_SRC_TYPE_CODE as TxnSrcTypeCode , SENDING_BANK_COUNTRY_CODE as SendingBankCountryCode , INTERMEDIARY_BANK_COUNTRY_CODE as IntBankCountryCode , CURRENCY_CODE_BASE as CurrencyCodeBase , RECV_BANK_COUNTRY_CODE as RecvBankCountryCode , RECV_CORR_COUNTRY_CODE as RecvCorrCountryCode , ORDER_INST_COUNTRY_CODE as OrderInstCountryCode , SENDER_CORR_COUNTRY_CODE as SenderCorrCountryCode , ULTIMATE_CREDITOR as UltimateCreditor , ULTIMATE_DEBTOR as UltimateDebtor , PAYMENT_INSTITUTION as PaymentInstitution , DEBTOR_COUNTRY_CODE as DebtorCountryCode , DEBTOR_ADDRESS as DebtorAddress , CREDITOR_COUNTRY_CODE as CreditorCountryCode , CREDITOR_ADDRESS as CreditorAddress FROM V_SM_CB_TRANSACTIONS ) V_SM_CB_TRANSACTIONS WHERE @WHERE@ ORDER BY RunTimestamp, SrcTxnUniqueId
